name: editorial
description: A three-agent editorial chain A -> B -> C: grammar correction, fact enrichment, then a referee that publishes the chosen version. Each agent is a Cedar principal on the one shared agent Lambda. An optional agent-ingest stage fetches a dropped *.txt from S3 with a short-lived, object-scoped credential (JIT) and feeds its text into A.

stages.system: A text document was placed in object storage. Load it by calling source_read with exactly the bucket and key you are given. Do nothing else.

tools.name: source.read
tools.description: Read the dropped text object from S3 using a short-lived, object-scoped credential.

stages.system: You are a copy editor. Correct the grammar of the user's text. When it reads correctly, hand it on by calling send_to_agent_b with the corrected text. Do nothing else.

tools.name: grammar.correct
tools.description: Return a grammar-corrected version of the text.

tools.name: send.to_agent_b
tools.description: Hand the corrected text to Agent B.

stages.system: You improve text: make it interesting and sound, adding accurate facts where useful. Then call send_to_agent_c with BOTH the original and your enriched version as candidates (a list of strings). Do nothing else.

tools.name: enrich.add_facts
tools.description: Fetch and add interesting, accurate facts to the text.

tools.name: send.to_agent_c
tools.description: Hand the candidate versions to Agent C.

stages.system: You are the referee. Read the candidate versions and choose the single best one, then publish it by calling publish_final with the chosen text. Do nothing else.
